Change c0391. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. III; 1831 Ch. XX.

Context before (unchanged): "Why do you answer me so roughly?"

1818 text: I replied: "surely it is not the custom of Englishmen to receive strangers so inhospitably." "I do not know," said the man, "what the custom of the English may be; but it is the custom of the Irish to hate villains."

1831 text: I replied; "surely it is not the custom of Englishmen to receive strangers so inhospitably." "I do not know," said the man, "what the custom of the English may be; but is the custom of the Irish to hate villains."
